label: Stores
description: Selects Store provider implementations and opens Store instances from provider URLs.

open.description: Resolves a configured provider URL and asynchronously materializes a Store instance. Repeated calls share an instance only when the matching provider definition enables Loader caching.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Store provider URL, such as mem: or mem:demo.

returns.description: Promise resolving to an instance implementing the Store contract.
